title: Agent registers with LiveKit Cloud
verification: No connection error, agent waits for participant

title: Participant joins and agent detects them
Audio input bridge subscribes to farmer mic
verification: Log shows '[BRIDGE] Subscribed to participant audio' or '[BRIDGE] Streaming participant audio to ADK'

title: ADK Live session starts and agent greets farmer
steps: Listen for agent greeting audio in browser
verification: You HEAR the agent speak a greeting. Log shows '[ADK] Agent:' transcription.

title: Voice triggers tool call (search_entity_history)
steps: Say clearly: 'How is cow three doing?'
verification: Log shows '[ADK] Farmer: ...' (input transcription) AND '[ADK] Tool call: search_entity_history'. Agent speaks COW-003 data back.

title: Voice triggers tool call (get_herd_stats)
steps: Say: 'How many cows have fed today?'
verification: Log shows '[ADK] Tool call: get_herd_stats'. Agent mentions '6 fed' and 'COW-003, COW-007 not fed'.

title: Video frames sent to Gemini Live
verification: Log shows '[VIDEO] Sent frame X to Gemini (Y bytes)' repeatedly

title: Agent describes what it sees when asked
steps: Say: 'What do you see right now?'
verification: Agent describes cattle/animals in the scene (not generic refusal). Shows awareness of video content.

title: Data channels flow to browser (scene_graph)
verification: test.html data panel shows scene_graph updates with entity counts

title: Data channels flow to browser (overlay)
verification: test.html data panel shows overlay updates with bounding boxes

title: Session survives 2+ minutes
verification: No crash, no audio degradation, agent responds to questions after 2 min

title: Context compression doesn't crash session
verification: No 'context window' errors in log. Session stays alive past initial context fill.

title: Proactive alert via voice (agent initiates)
verification: Agent spontaneously mentions an observation or alert without farmer asking
